layout_summary: An asymmetric split composition on a pure white background places a composite product-and-shoe visual bleeding off the left edge against a stacked parody title block on the right. A single-line red tagline anchors the bottom across nearly the full width of the canvas.

alignment_axes: DEVIL (x=46.5%) and BISCOFF (x=46%) share an optical left alignment axis near x=46%
DEVIL (right edge x=89.5%) and BISCOFF (right edge x=90.5%) share an optical right alignment axis near x=90%
THE (center x=57.5%) and EATS (center x=69%) are staggered asymmetrically inside the DEVIL/BISCOFF block
Bottom tagline is horizontally centered on the canvas (x=7% to x=93%, center x=50%)
whitespace: 10% empty top margin above the shoe tip and 30.5% above the title block
10% horizontal gutter separating the right edge of the shoe/jar (x=36%) from the title block (x=46%)
37% open white band beneath the title block (y=55.5% to y=92.5%) on the right half
9.5% vertical gap between the bottom of the jar drip (y=83%) and the bottom tagline (y=92.5%)

scene.subject: A glossy crimson high-heeled stiletto shoe whose thin heel morphs into a three-pronged red pitchfork dipping directly into an open glass jar of smooth caramel-brown biscuit spread, with thick spread overflowing and dripping down the right side of the jar onto the ground
scene.composition: Positioned in the left third, the shoe enters from the left edge at a steep diagonal (y=10% to y=52.5%) while its pitchfork heel descends vertically along x=24.5% into the open jar sitting at y=55.5% to y=83%
scene.camera: Straight-on eye-level studio product angle, sharp focus front to back, slight telephoto compression
scene.lighting: Bright, crisp studio lighting from upper right with strong specular white highlights along the glossy red shoe and caramelized spread drips, casting a soft diffused ground shadow to the left of the jar base
negative_space: x=36% to x=100%, y=0% to y=100% (entire right two-thirds is pure white ground for the typography)
x=0% to x=100%, y=83% to y=100% (clean white lower band for the tagline)

elements.text: Don't be silly Andrea, everybody wants this.

ornaments.description: Devil-tail arrowhead extending upward from the right diagonal stroke of the letter V in DEVIL

why_it_works: Instant cultural recognition: replicates the iconic white-space, crimson stiletto-pitchfork, and serif title lockup of The Devil Wears Prada poster.
Generous negative space (over 60% pure white) keeps the glossy red shoe, overflowing spread jar, and high-contrast black/red typography crisp and uncluttered.
Visual-to-copy flow pulls the eye down the red heel into the branded jar, across to the punchline title, and down to the red quote anchoring the base.
